events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW street activation for eos Dewy Lip Shine, with product discovery, sampling, sweet treats and photo moments from a branded truck in SoHo.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise Dewy Lip Shine product sampling and sweet treats at the public activation.
events.caveats: Multiple current sources agree on Tuesday, September 15, 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway and describe the activation as open to the public. No advance RSVP requirement is published. Samples and treats are promotional and may be supply-limited.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway in SoHo. Walk-in public activation; arrive earlier if sampling is the priority.

events.event_name: Hempz × Ulta Beauty Herald Square Pop-Up
events.address: Ulta Beauty Herald Square, 2 Herald Square / 1328 Broadway, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A Hempz Serene Waters with Magnesium body-care pop-up truck outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square, built around a calm-down/self-care experience.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise free magnesium iced teas, iced lavender cold-foam matchas, free Serene Waters with Magnesium mini body lotions and scratch-off prizes while supplies last. The first 50 guests in line are advertised to receive a Calm Kit.
events.caveats: Current event listings agree on Tuesday, September 15, 12:30–6:30 PM outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square. A NYC street-activity listing also places a Hempz activation on East 34th Street between Fifth and Sixth Avenues that day. Free items are explicitly while supplies last; gifts with purchase inside Ulta are separate from the free walk-in activation.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12:30–6:30 PM outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square. Arrive near opening if the first-50 Calm Kit is the priority.

events.event_name: Walk the Runway at Century 21 NYC
events.address: Century 21 NYC, 22 Cortlandt St, New York, NY 10007
events.what_it_is: A two-day public Fashion Week runway experience on Century 21 NYC's main floor where anyone can get in line, walk the runway and be filmed by the store team.
events.what_is_free: Century 21's official event page says every walker receives a free tote, up to five iron-on patches pressed onto it and a $21-off-$100 in-store card, while tote/patch supplies last.
events.caveats: The official Century 21 page confirms no ticket, invitation or online sign-up is required. Every runway walk is filmed for Century 21 Instagram/TikTok stories; participating in the walk means appearing in that footage. Totes and patches are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 and Wednesday, September 16 from 12–6 PM. Enter on the Dey Street side and follow the runway on the main floor. Come early for the fullest giveaway supply.

events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Pop-Up
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day oversized beauty experience in Gansevoort Plaza tied to Mary Kay's Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign, with product discovery, beauty touch-ups and interactive photo moments.
events.what_is_free: The Mary Kay organizer Eventbrite advertises 10,000 free makeup and skin-care products, and current public listings also advertise beauty touch-ups and interactive experiences.
events.caveats: Mary Kay U.S. is the organizer on the live Eventbrite page. Multiple current sources describe the physical activation as free and open to the public; a free Eventbrite registration is available, but the corroborating public-access sources do not establish registration as mandatory. Promotional products may run out.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–7 PM. A free organizer Eventbrite registration is available; public-access listings do not establish it as required. Arrive earlier for promotional product availability.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Ave between W 14th and W 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A Bobbi Brown beauty-newsstand takeover introducing Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with sampling, refreshments, scratch-off giveaways and a mirrored photo moment.
events.what_is_free: The Bobbi Brown organizer Eventbrite advertises a complimentary VEFB+ sample, refreshments and croissants, scratch-off prizes and giveaways while supplies last; the first 100 guests in line are advertised to receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: Bobbi Brown Cosmetics is the organizer on the live Eventbrite registration page. Registration is the advertised admission path there. Samples, food and prizes are while supplies last, and photo/video content will be captured for Bobbi Brown social/digital channels.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17 from 12–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle. Register through the Bobbi Brown organizer Eventbrite page; arrive early if the first-100 deluxe sample is the priority.
